segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בַּעַל חָמֵשׁ רַגְלַיִם, אוֹ שֶׁאֵין לוֹ אֶלָּא שָׁלֹשׁ, וְשֶׁרַגְלָיו קְלוּטוֹת כְּשֶׁל חֲמוֹר, וְהַשָּׁחוּל וְהַכָּסוּל. אֵיזֶהוּ שָׁחוּל? שֶׁנִּשְׁמְטָה יְרֵיכוֹ. וְכָסוּל? שֶׁאַחַת מִירֵיכוֹתָיו גְּבוֹהוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» An animal «with five legs, or» one «that has only three, or» one «whose» hooves on its «legs were closed like» those «of a donkey» and not split, «or the shaḥul, or the kasul» may be slaughtered. «What is a shaḥul?» It is an animal with «a thighbone that was dislocated. And» what is «a kasul?» It is an animal whose build is asymmetrical in «that one of its thighs is higher» than the other.

moves.summary: lists leg blemishes and defines shaḥul and kasul

positions.claim: five or three legs, closed hooves, dislocated thigh (shaḥul) or uneven thighs (kasul) are blemishes
